maxOrgsOwned.description:
MaxOrgsOwned limits how many organizations a single user account can own.
Enforced at org creation time against the user's best existing plan.

monthlyUnits.description:
MonthlyUnits caps faces processed per calendar month (metering units).
0 = unlimited. Deliberately 0 for every plan until unit pricing is final —
the enforcement plumbing (middleware.UnitQuota) is wired but dormant.

details.description:
Details carries machine-readable context for codes that define it
(MULTIPLE_FACES: faceCount and faces). Omitted otherwise.

requireLiveness.description:
RequireLiveness makes enrolment require a liveness token. Optional;
defaults to false.

status.description: "ok" — errors use the standard error envelope

term_end.description: RFC 3339; moves forward when the subscription renews

inviteToken.description:
InviteToken comes from an invitation link. The address must be the one
invited; the account is then verified and joins the organization.

faceSelection.description: Omitting it leaves the current policy alone.

requireLiveness.description:
A pointer, so omitting it leaves the current setting alone rather than
quietly switching liveness off.

info.description: Multi-Tenant Face Recognition API. Supports user auth, organization management, API key management, face collection CRUD, face registration, 1:1 verification, and 1:N identification using pgvector.
info.title: LiveXFace — Face Recognition API as a Service

post.description: Judge a sequence of frames (blink, head turn and the passive model). Send the frames in order as frame_0, frame_1, … up to frame_49; at least 5 are required. This stateless check returns a verdict only and issues no liveness token; to enrol into a collection that requires liveness, complete a liveness session instead.

post.description: Start a liveness session: the server picks the steps the person must perform, in order (one blink and one or two head turns, turn_left and turn_right meaning the person's own left and right). Show them to the person, capture frames while they perform them, and submit the frames to the session before expiresAt (60 seconds by default). The session is bound to this collection.

post.description: Submit the frames for a liveness session, once, before it expires. Every step must appear in the frames in the order given, and the blink and passive rules of the active check must hold. A pass returns a single-use livenessToken, valid for 5 minutes and bound to this collection, for enrolling with liveness_token. The session is used up by any submission except one with fewer than 5 frames.

parameters.description: Session ID from creating the session
parameters.name: session_id

frame_0.description: First frame; continue with frame_1 … frame_49 (at least 5 frames)
